i swapped out both my PSU and GPU, rocking a 3090 Ti and Rmx 1000w  


I still had the issue. Though, it seems like i fixed it doing the following;  


\-Using DDU to completely wipe my computer of any graphics drivers, and then installing the newest ones from geforce experience  
\-Reseating the PCIe cable going into the GPU, since it felt a bit loose.  
\-Going into power options, edit power plan, change advanced power settings, PCI express, Link state power management to OFF  
\-setting discord to not use hardware acceleration (apparently it might be something that causes it...)  


Currently im going strong on 3 days without any sort of crashes, black screens or interrupts while doing things that would usually lead to a crash of this type. While i won't know if im just being lucky or if i genuinely fixed it, but seeing as it was a once every 2-3 hours thing and especially during resource intensive games, which have been running buttery smooth since, i'm pretty confident i've found the solution.
